why: Second hero re-roll: 06b fixed the shell and the fight pose but Barnaby came out a cute cartoon mascot (front eyes, smile, glossy stripes) against the wild-animal model sheet. This subject pins the anatomy, the matte skin and the eye placement.

renders.name: banner-pier59-danceoff
renders.subject: Dance partners side by side, mid synchronized dance move on a flooded folded pier floor, partners never opponents: {CORDULA} twirling her black paddle overhead like a baton, one boot splashing on the beat; beside her and dwarfing her, {BARNABY_DANCE}, a real wild octopus in three-quarter view, matte rough scarred skin, eyes on the sides of his head with horizontal pupils like a real Giant Pacific Octopus, no smile, no mouth visible, no cartoon, no mascot, crimson and white bands pulsing through dark skin as a dance light show, eight immense arms curling in rhythm across the wet timbers; a tiny round green lumpsucker fish in a tide pool below, ruined pier and the rainy Seattle skyline behind, violet stage beams through rain

place.where: hero slot at the top (the Gertie wreck plate stands in until this lands)
place.alt: Cordula in black on black on grey dancing with her paddle beside kraken-scale Barnaby flashing crimson and white, on the folded Pier 59 floor
